verdict.rationale: The pack shows only that JMAP is an open, patent-free protocol with third-party implementations, plus a bare page title 'Open source and standards | Fastmail'. Neither shows that Fastmail's own product source is published under an open license. An open protocol standard is an adjacent openness feature, not readable product source, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
